Sorry about the double charge, that's frustrating. Since both have posted, please reply with the order number (LF-204518, which I already have) and the **last four digits** of the card that was charged. Please don't send your full card number, security code or any passwords.

Once the duplicate is confirmed, it will be refunded within **3 business days**. After that, the refund reaches your bank in 5-10 business days for cards, or 3-5 business days for digital wallets.

One thing to check first: if your order shipped in several parcels, you can see one charge per parcel, which would be expected rather than a duplicate.
